name: Upsert Provider
plugin_description: Creates or updates a provider record in Kizen and optionally links it to a provider reference record.
action_description: Upserts a provider record in the Providers object using the NPI as the lookup key. Optionally links the resulting provider record to the given provider reference record.

inputs.name: matched_npi
inputs.label: Matched NPI
inputs.description: NPI of the provider to upsert

inputs.name: matched_provider_name
inputs.label: Matched Provider Name
inputs.description: Full name of the matched provider

inputs.name: matched_street
inputs.label: Matched Street
inputs.description: Practice street address of the matched provider

inputs.name: matched_city
inputs.label: Matched City
inputs.description: Practice city of the matched provider

inputs.name: matched_state
inputs.label: Matched State
inputs.description: Practice state of the matched provider

inputs.name: matched_zip
inputs.label: Matched Zip
inputs.description: Practice zip code of the matched provider

inputs.name: ref_name
inputs.label: Reference Name
inputs.description: Name of the provider reference record to link to the upserted provider

inputs.name: call_summary_name
inputs.label: Call Summary Name
inputs.description: Name of the call summary record to link to the upserted provider

outputs.name: provider_id
outputs.label: Provider ID
outputs.description: Kizen record ID of the created or updated provider record
